segments.text: What is mantra, how it is made and evolved?

Ancient saints and sages discovered special sounds in the universe that create specific vibrations. They used these sounds to form mantras, which help connect with cosmic energy. When a person chants a mantra, its vibration matches similar energies already present in the universe, creating a strong spiritual connection.

For example, imagine an aspirant in Ashayein who chants the mantra “Jai Siya Ram” every day with full dedication. As he continue chanting, the energy from the mantra starts activating his chakras and awakening his kundalini shakti . Over time, as this energy rises, it eventually opens his third eye , increasing his spiritual awareness and inner strength.

In Ashayein , mantra chanting is the foundation of all spiritual practices. It not only awakens an aspirant’s inner energy but also helps them learn powerful spiritual techniques. Through Mantra Shakti , an aspirant gain the ability to protect himself from negative energies, including harmful tantrik kriyas like Maran (destructive energy), Stambhan (blocking progress), Uchattan (causing distractions), Bhedan (creating confusion), and Videshan (causing division). By continuously chanting and staying connected to Mantra Raj Sarkar , the aspirant gains both spiritual power and divine protection.

In the first dimension , a mantra moves either forward or backward when chanted. As an aspirant continues his practice, the mantra gains more movement—it can go forward, backward, upward, downward, left, and right. At this stage, the mantra also develops the ability to heal others.

For example, imagine an aspirant who begins chanting a mantra. At first, the mantra only moves in one direction. But with consistent practice, they start noticing that the mantra’s energy expands in different ways, allowing them to use it for healing and protection.
In the fourth dimension , the mantra moves both downward and upward, enabling the aspirant’s astral body to work in multiple places at the same time.

Finally, in the seventh dimension , the mantra becomes even more powerful. It can now travel beyond the physical and astral realms, reaching different loks (spiritual worlds), allowing the aspirant to connect with higher divine energies
